findings.description: One entry per issue. An empty array is a valid review.

line.description: Line in the NEW version of the file

issue.description: What is wrong and what input or caller triggers it

detected_pattern.description: Short kebab-case name for the code construct that triggered this finding, e.g. sql-string-interpolation

status.description: Re-reviews only: new issue, or one already reported that the new commits did not fix
